faq.q: What standard dimensional tolerances apply to Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94)?
faq.a: Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) is manufactured to ISO 2768-m medium tolerances (±0.1 mm for basic dimensions up to 30 mm, ±0.2 mm for 30-120 mm). Functional mating surfaces can be held to ±0.025 mm with Ra 0.8 µm surface finish. For split cotter pin, specific tolerance classes can be quoted based on functional requirements.
